description: A narrow pawnshop with a grille over every pane and a window crammed floor-to-ceiling with other people's worst days: dead men's watches, hocked tools, a wedding band on a nail. A buzzing sign reads IN HOCK WE TRUST · WE BUY · WE HOLD · WE DON'T REMEMBER. The security shutter is up a hopeful eighteen inches. Something inside is always quietly appraising you.
name: In Hock We Trust
